# YM31: 平湖秋月 Pinghu Qiuyue, "Level Lake and Autumn Moon"

Wave 1 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM31` · Page: `/scenes/#YM31` · Row: `research/buildings/YM31-pinghu-qiuyue/`

## What it was

平湖秋月 Pinghu Qiuyue, "Autumn Moon on the Calm Lake", in the north-west corner of 福海 (S05 j82:15b; E1912): a three-bay main hall set against a hill and facing the lake, with plank bridges on either side (S40; E1896). Around it 流水音 to the west, 花屿兰皋 by the river out of a gap in the hills to the north-east, 两峰插云 across a bridge to the south-east, 山水乐 further south-east, and 君子轩 and 藏密楼 to the north (S05 j82:15b; E1912). In 1810 Jiaqing rebuilt part of it and named it 镜远洲, writing on it every year to 1820 (S360; E1917). Burned in October 1860.

From the inventory row: **changed** 1810 part rebuilt, new plaque 镜远洲; **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S02, S08, S01, S360).

## The scene itself

### The leaf of 1744, its poem and preface

Leaf 31 of the 1744 album, a 浣溪纱 lyric. Preface: "倚山面湖竹樹䝉密左右支板橋以通步屐" (against the hill, facing the lake, dense with bamboo and trees, plank bridges on left and right for walkers). The lake runs to tens of qing and on deep autumn nights moonlight and water join the sky; the view equals Su Shi's causeway on 西湖. The lyric opens "不辨天光與水光" (S40, printed in S05 j82:15b-16a; E1896).

### How later sources differ

Qianlong wrote on 君子轩, 藏密楼 and 夏隐亭 from 1759 to 1795 (S360; E1897-E1905, E1914-E1916); 藏密楼 is climbed by red stairs and has green windows ("丹梯拾级因髙迥，绿牖凭虚纳远通", S361 v2 p.368; E1923). Jiaqing's 镜远洲 of 1810 (E1917); Daoguang wrote on 平湖秋月 in 1823 and 1824, Xianfeng in 1857 (E1909-E1911). The Yangshi Lei sheets are in S13 (E1918). Note: S361 files the poems on 流水音 and 藏密楼 under 澡身浴德, not under this scene (E1920, E1923, E1924).

## Interior and setting

### Interior

Plaque 平湖秋月 in Yongzheng's hand; 流水音, 花屿兰皋 and the others in Qianlong's (S05 j82:15b; E1912). No inventory seen.

### The garden around it

Dense bamboo and trees, plank bridges on either side, the hill behind (E1896); smartweed and lotus ("蓼煙荷露", E1896). At 流水音 water drips from piled rocks into a cave ("叠石崚嶒泉细注，泠然岩底出清音", Jiaqing 1798; E1920). A river and a hill gap at 花屿兰皋; a bridge to 两峰插云 (E1912).
